examples.en: In the rather unobvious text box, type ami-aa5abac3.
examples.zh: 在不显眼的文本框中，输入ami - aa5abac3。

examples.en: In mathematical science connections are exhibited which are extremely unobvious.
examples.zh: 在数学科学中，极不明显的联系被呈现出来。

examples.en: This article studies some unobvious difference indexes of sports by comparing the male and female university students.
examples.zh: 对男、女大学生体育运动与“性差”中“非显性差异”的有关指标进行对比研究。
